title: Graduation Day
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Activate / GoTo / Item

Quest Description: Speak to the Townston Commander in Townston about your new assignment.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: Dew Valley

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Speak to the Townston Commander in Townston about your new assignment.

Offer:

Great hustle out there Dungeon Runner. I've been keeping my eye on you during these assignments and I must say I am impressed. It takes a lot to impress me too; I am not just your average Kingdom Representative you know. I am an important man! Do you think I was just handed this assignment as a way for Townston to get rid of me, or something? Not at all! I asked for this post so that I could find promising Dungeon Runners like yourself and send you on to the big league!

Here, take your file. It contains all of my notes and reports on your progress. Take this to the Townston Commander and let him know I sent you. With a recommendation from me, you are bound to rise through the ranks of Dungeon Runners quickly!

It was an honor to have mentored you. Make me proud out there! One day, you could even have position of prominence like myself!

Turn-in:

Wait, who sent you? Oh....Sir Prize...right. So that's where he ended up? Huh, learn something new every day.

Oh cool, you brought me something to sit on. Not very flashy, but it sure looks sturdy. Heavy, too. I wonder what it's filled with.

Now let's see what assignments I have for you. Looks like you get to choose today, congratulations.

Objectives:

  • Permanent Record ×1
  • Find the Townston Commander
  • Speak to Townston Commander ×1

Client level range: 2–100
